Win $30,000 in Anthropic bStocks Token Now!

The timer starts counting down from 60:00 once you click the button. If another user clicks the button before it hits 00:00, the countdown will reset.

Important Note: The campaign opens for participation on 2026-11-12 08:00 (UTC)*, but the Button Game itself only officially starts only when 50,000 participants participate (users should monitor the activity landing page for this exact start time). Accumulate at least $100 equivalent in trading volume across any trading pairs (except zero-fee pairs) on Binance Spot or Convert.
Accumulate at least $500 equivalent across any trading pairs in trading volume on Binance Futures.
Trade a total of at least $100 equivalent on eligible Stocks trading pairs, buy orders only.

Daily Sharing Task: Click [Share] and invite a friend to participate in the game together via the invitation link and earn 2 extra clicks if the friend uses your link to participate, refreshes daily at 00:00 UTC .
*New Users refer to users who registered on Binance after 2026-11-12 08:00 (UTC).
*First-time traders refer to users who have not traded on Binance Spot or Binance Convert prior to 2026-11-12 08:00 (UTC).
How to Interpret the Rankings on the Landing Page
Binance will track all users’ performance according to how close they are to reaching 00:00 before being interrupted. The closer a user gets to 00:00, the higher their ranking.
Users can complete bonus tasks as mentioned above to earn more clicks.
If by the end of the Activity Period, no one manages to count down to 00:00, the user(s) with the highest ranking with their countdown closest to 00:00, will be eligible for the token reward.
If there is more than one user with the highest ranking, the eligible winners will have to split the token reward equally.
